title: Quiet-hours offer without saying what quiet hours are
testerLines: I think I should be done eating for the day around 11pm because usually I like to have a late night snack every day
whatWentWrong: ZOH replied "Want me to move quiet hours to 11:30 pm to 9 am so my reminders reach you at 11?" The tester had never heard of quiet hours.
shouldHaveHappened: Before the plan, ZOH explains in plain words that by default it doesn't text between 10 pm and 9 am so it won't wake or bother them, then offers once to move that window so it can still reach them around 11; one question in that text. After the yes, it saves the new quiet hours and carries on toward the plan, without asking about quiet hours again.

answers.what: hit a protein target, about 160 g a day

history.text: Perfect. What time are you usually done eating for the day? That's when you'll send me your log.
